license_required.quote: No person shall practice dentistry without first applying for and obtaining a license for such purpose from the Department.

issuing_authority.value: Department of Financial and Professional Regulation
issuing_authority.quote: "Department" means the Department of Financial and Professional Regulation.

type.quote: There is created a Board of Dentistry, to be composed of persons designated from time to time by the Secretary, as follows: Eleven persons, 8 of whom have been dentists for a period of 5 years or more; 2 of whom have been dental hygienists for a period of 5 years or more, and one public member.

umbrella_agency.value: Department of Financial and Professional Regulation
umbrella_agency.quote: "Department" means the Department of Financial and Professional Regulation.

age_minimum.quote: Be at least 21 years of age and of good moral character.

moral_character_required.quote: Be at least 21 years of age and of good moral character.

degree_required.value: DDS or DMD from accredited dental school
degree_required.quote: Present satisfactory evidence of completion of dental education by graduation from a dental college or school in the United States or Canada approved by the Department. The Department shall not approve any dental college or school which does not require at least (A) 60 semester hours of collegiate credit or the equivalent in acceptable subjects from a college or university before admission, and (B) completion of at least 4 academic years of instruction or the equivalent in an approved dental college or school that is accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association

accrediting_body.value: Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association
accrediting_body.quote: completion of at least 4 academic years of instruction or the equivalent in an approved dental college or school that is accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association

exams.name: National Board Dental Examination
exams.jurisdiction: national (Joint Commission on National Dental Examinations)
exams.quote: Present satisfactory evidence that the applicant has passed the integrated National Board Dental Examination administered by the Joint Commission on National Dental Examinations

exams.name: Regional Clinical Examination
exams.jurisdiction: regional testing services (CRDTS, SRTA, WREB, CDCA, or CITA)
exams.quote: has successfully completed an examination conducted by one of the following regional testing services: the Central Regional Dental Testing Service, Inc. (CRDTS), the Southern Regional Testing Agency, Inc. (SRTA), the Western Regional Examining Board (WREB), the Commission on Dental Competency Assessments (CDCA), or the Council of Interstate Testing Agencies (CITA)

interval_years.quote: The renewal period for each license issued under this Act shall be 3 years.

renewal_fee_usd.quote: the fee for application for renewal of a license as a dentist or specialist is $100 per year

required.quote: The Department shall promulgate rules of continuing education for persons licensed under this Act. In establishing rules, the Department shall require a minimum of 48 hours of study in approved courses for dentists during each 3-year licensing period

hours_per_period.quote: a minimum of 48 hours of study in approved courses for dentists during each 3-year licensing period

period_years.quote: a minimum of 48 hours of study in approved courses for dentists during each 3-year licensing period

available.quote: Any person who has been lawfully licensed to practice dentistry, including the practice of a licensed dental specialty, or dental hygiene in another state or territory or as a member of the military service which has and maintains a standard for the practice of dentistry, a dental specialty, or dental hygiene at least equal to that now maintained in this State, or if the requirements for licensure in such state or territory in which the applicant was licensed were, at the date of his or her licensure, substantially equivalent to the requirements then in force in this State, and who has been lawfully engaged in the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene for at least 2 years immediately preceding the filing of his or her application to practice in this State and who shall deposit with the Department a duly attested certificate from the Board of the state or territory in which he or she is licensed, certifying to the fact of his or her licensing and of his or her being a person of good moral character may, upon payment of the required fee, be granted a license to practice dentistry, a dental specialty, or dental hygiene in this State

requirements.value: Applicant must have been lawfully licensed in another state/territory with equivalent standards, engaged in practice for at least 2 years, and provide certificate of good moral character from licensing board
requirements.quote: Any person who has been lawfully licensed to practice dentistry, including the practice of a licensed dental specialty, or dental hygiene in another state or territory or as a member of the military service which has and maintains a standard for the practice of dentistry, a dental specialty, or dental hygiene at least equal to that now maintained in this State, or if the requirements for licensure in such state or territory in which the applicant was licensed were, at the date of his or her licensure, substantially equivalent to the requirements then in force in this State, and who has been lawfully engaged in the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene for at least 2 years immediately preceding the filing of his or her application

exists.quote: There is created a Board of Dentistry, to be composed of persons designated from time to time by the Secretary, as follows: Eleven persons, 8 of whom have been dentists for a period of 5 years or more; 2 of whom have been dental hygienists for a period of 5 years or more, and one public member.

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall practice dentistry without first applying for and obtaining a license for such purpose from the Department.

credential_type.quote: The Department shall issue a license authorizing practice as a dentist to any person who qualifies for a license under this Act.

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall practice dentistry without first applying for and obtaining a license for such purpose from the Department.

title_protection.quote: No dentist shall announce or hold himself or herself out to the public as a specialist or as being specially qualified in any particular branch of dentistry unless he or she is licensed to practice in that specialty of dentistry.

scope_protection.quote: No person shall practice dentistry without first applying for and obtaining a license for such purpose from the Department.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or misrepresentation in applying for or procuring a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or misrepresentation in applying for or procuring a license under this Act, or in connection with applying for renewal of a license under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety due to substance abuse or addiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inability to practice with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety as a result of habitual or excessive use or addiction to alcohol, narcotics, stimulants, or any other chemical agent or drug.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or repeated violations of Department rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful or repeated violations of the rules of the Department of Public Health or Department of Nuclear Safety.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Division of fees or agreeing to split fees with non-professionals for referrals
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Division of fees or agreeing to split or divide the fees received for dental services with any person for bringing or referring a patient, except in regard to referral services as provided for under Section 45, or assisting in the care or treatment of a patient, without the knowledge of the patient or his or her legal representative.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing or aiding unlicensed persons to practice dentistry or dental hygiene
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employing, procuring, inducing, aiding or abetting a person not licensed or registered as a dentist or dental hygienist to engage in the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making false or misleading representations to influence dental patronage
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any misrepresentations or false promises, directly or indirectly, to influence, persuade or induce dental patronage.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Professional association with unlicensed practitioners or lending name to illegal practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Professional connection or association with or lending his or her name to another for the illegal practice of dentistry by another, or professional connection or association with any person, firm or corporation holding himself, herself, themselves, or itself out in any manner contrary to this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining practice, money, or things of value by false or fraudulent representations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining or seeking to obtain practice, money, or any other things of value by false or fraudulent representations, but not limited to, engaging in such fraudulent practice to defraud the medical assistance program of the Department of Healthcare and Family Services (formerly Department of Public Aid) under the Illinois Public Aid Code.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing under a false or assumed name
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing under a false or, except as provided by law, an assumed name.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in dishonorable, unethical, or unprofessional conduct likely to deceive or harm the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in dishonorable, unethical, or unprofessional conduct of a character likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or dishonesty-related misdemeanor
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction by plea of guilty or nolo contendere, finding of guilt, jury verdict, or entry of judgment or by sentencing for any crime, including, but not limited to, convictions, preceding sentences of supervision, conditional discharge, or first offender probation, under the laws of any jurisdiction of the United States that (i) is a felony under the laws of this State or (ii) is a misdemeanor, an essential element of which is dishonesty, or that is directly related to the practice of dentistry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting supervised personnel to perform unauthorized operations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Permitting a dental hygienist, dental assistant or other person under his or her supervision to perform any operation not authorized by this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Supervising more than 4 dental hygienists at one time
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Permitting more than 4 dental hygienists to be employed under his or her supervision at any one time.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of the Dental Practice Act or rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A violation of any provision of this Act or any rules promulgated under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Taking impressions for or using services of persons violating the Act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Taking impressions for or using the services of any person, firm or corporation violating this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating advertising provisions of the Act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any provision of Section 45 relating to advertising.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Discipline by another U.S. jurisdiction or foreign nation on substantially equivalent grounds
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Discipline by another U.S. jurisdiction or foreign nation, if at least one of the grounds for the discipline is the same or substantially equivalent to those set forth within this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully failing to report suspected child abuse or neglect
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully failing to report an instance of suspected child abuse or neglect as required by the Abused and Neglected Child Reporting Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross negligence in practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross negligence in practice under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use or prescription of narcotics or controlled substances for non-therapeutic purposes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The use or prescription for use of narcotics or controlled substances or designated products as listed in the Illinois Controlled Substances Act, in any way other than for therapeutic purposes.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully making or filing false records or reports
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully making or filing false records or reports in his or her practice as a dentist, including, but not limited to, false records to support claims against the dental assistance program of the Department of Healthcare and Family Services (formerly Illinois Department of Public Aid).

disciplinary_grounds.description: Professional incompetence manifested by poor standards of care
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Professional incompetence as manifested by poor standards of care.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Physical or mental illness resulting in inability to practice with reasonable judgment, skill or safety
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Physical or mental illness, including, but not limited to, deterioration through the aging process, or loss of motor skills which results in a dentist's inability to practice dentistry with reasonable judgment, skill or safety.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross or repeated irregularities in billing for services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross or repeated irregularities in billing for services rendered to a patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Continuing active practice while knowingly having a communicable disease
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Continuing the active practice of dentistry while knowingly having any infectious, communicable, or contagious disease proscribed by rule or regulation of the Department.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being named as perpetrator in indicated child abuse or neglect report
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being named as a perpetrator in an indicated report by the Department of Children and Family Services pursuant to the Abused and Neglected Child Reporting Act, and upon proof by clear and convincing evidence that the licensee has caused a child to be an abused child or neglected child as defined in the Abused and Neglected Child Reporting Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating the Health Care Worker Self-Referral Act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating the Health Care Worker Self-Referral Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandonment of a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abandonment of a patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Mental incompetency as declared by a court
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Mental incompetency as declared by a court of competent jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of probationary terms after license placed on probation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A finding by the Department that the licensee, after having his or her license placed on probationary status, has violated the terms of probation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Material misstatement in furnishing information to the Department
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Material misstatement in furnishing information to the Department.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to provide information in response to Department request within 60 days
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing, within 60 days, to provide information in response to a written request by the Department in the course of an investigation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Immoral conduct including sexual misconduct related to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Immoral conduct in the commission of any act, including, but not limited to, commission of an act of sexual misconduct related to the licensee's practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cheating on or attempting to subvert the licensing examination
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Cheating on or attempting to subvert the licensing examination administered under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Pattern of practice demonstrating incapacity or incompetence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A pattern of practice or other behavior that demonstrates incapacity or incompetence to practice under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to establish and maintain patient care and treatment records
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to establish and maintain records of patient care and treatment as required under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to provide copies of dental records as required by law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to provide copies of dental records as required by law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to give 30 days notice of office closure to patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of a licensed dentist who owns or is employed at a dental office to give notice of an office closure to his or her patients at least 30 days prior to the office closure pursuant to Section 50.1.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain a sanitary work environment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to maintain a sanitary work environment.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with teledentistry provisions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the provisions of Section 17.2 of this Act.

definition_quote.value: the healing art which is concerned with the examination, diagnosis, treatment planning, and care of conditions within the human oral cavity and its adjacent tissues and structures
definition_quote.quote: "Dentistry" means the healing art which is concerned with the examination, diagnosis, treatment planning, and care of conditions within the human oral cavity and its adjacent tissues and structures, as further specified in Section 17.

value: diagnosis and treatment of oral diseases
correction of malpositions of teeth and jaws
use of X-ray machines for diagnostic purposes
methods_authorized.quote: A person practices dentistry, within the meaning of this Act: (1) Who represents himself or herself as being able to diagnose or diagnoses, treats, prescribes, or operates for any disease, pain, deformity, deficiency, injury, or physical condition of the human tooth, teeth, alveolar process, gums, or jaw; ... (4) Who uses an X-Ray machine or X-Ray films for dental diagnostic purposes; ... (5) Who extracts a human tooth or teeth, or corrects or attempts to correct malpositions of the human teeth or jaws; ... (7) Who uses or administers local or general anesthetics in the treatment of dental or oral diseases or in any preparation incident to a dental operation of any kind or character; ... (8) Who takes material or digital scans for final impressions of the human tooth, teeth, or jaws or performs any phase of any operation incident to the replacement of a part of a tooth, a tooth, teeth, or associated tissues by means of a filling, a crown, a bridge, a denture, or other appliance; ... (9) Who offers to furnish, supply, construct, reproduce, or repair, or who furnishes, supplies, constructs, reproduces, or repairs, prosthetic dentures, bridges, or other substitutes for natural teeth to the user or prospective user thereof; ... (11) Who takes material or digital scans for final impressions of human teeth or places his or her hands in the mouth of any person for the purpose of applying teeth whitening materials

drug_authority.value: Dentists may prescribe and dispense drugs and medicines in good faith for dental purposes
drug_authority.quote: Any dentist who dispenses any drug or medicine shall dispense such drug or medicine in good faith and shall affix to the box, bottle, vessel or package containing the same a label indicating: (a) the date on which such drug or medicine is dispensed; (b) the name of the patient; (c) the last name of the person dispensing such drug or medicine; (d) the directions for use thereof; and (e) the proprietary name or names or the established name or names of the drug or medicine, the dosage and quantity

sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: No licensed dentist shall administer general anesthesia, deep sedation, or moderate sedation without first applying for and obtaining a permit for such purpose from the Department.

sedation_permit_onsite_inspection_requir.quote: establish the standards for properly equipped dental facilities (other than licensed hospitals and ambulatory surgical treatment centers) in which general anesthesia, deep sedation, or moderate sedation is administered, as necessary to protect public safety

specialist_license_available.quote: The Department shall issue a license authorizing practice as a specialist in any particular branch of dentistry to any dentist who has complied with the requirements established for that particular branch of dentistry at the time of making application.

specialty_practice_scope_restriction.quote: No dentist shall announce or hold himself or herself out to the public as a specialist or as being specially qualified in any particular branch of dentistry unless he or she is licensed to practice in that specialty of dentistry.

specialty_advertising_disclaimer_require.quote: any advertisement which announces the availability of endodontics, pediatric dentistry, periodontics, prosthodontics, orthodontics and dentofacial orthopedics, oral and maxillofacial surgery, or oral and maxillofacial radiology by a general dentist or by a licensed specialist who is not licensed in that specialty shall include a disclaimer stating that the dentist does not hold a license in that specialty.

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: "Supervision" means supervision of a dental hygienist or a dental assistant requiring that a dentist authorize the procedure, remain in the dental facility while the procedure is performed, and approve the work performed by the dental hygienist or dental assistant before dismissal of the patient, but does not mean that the dentist must be present at all times in the treatment room. "General supervision" means supervision of a dental hygienist requiring that the patient be a patient of record, that the dentist examine the patient in accordance with Section 18 prior to treatment by the dental hygienist, and that the dentist authorize the procedures which are being carried out by a notation in the patient's record, but not requiring that a dentist be present when the authorized procedures are being performed.

collaborative_agreement_available.quote: A licensed dentist must hold an appropriate permit issued under this Section in order to perform dentistry while a nurse anesthetist administers moderate sedation, and a valid written collaborative agreement must exist between the dentist and the nurse anesthetist, in accordance with the Nurse Practice Act.

collaborative_agreement_max_hygienists_p.quote: A dentist entering into an agreement under this Section may supervise and enter into agreements for public health supervision with 4 public health dental hygienists. This shall be in addition to the limit of 4 dental hygienists per dentist set forth in subsection (g) of Section 18 of this Act.

advanced_practice_permit_available.quote: A public health dental hygienist may provide services to patients: (1) who are eligible for Medicaid or (2) who are uninsured and whose household income is not greater than 300% of the federal poverty level.

value: uninsured patients with household income not greater than 300% of federal poverty level
advanced_practice_eligible_patient_popul.quote: A public health dental hygienist may provide services to patients: (1) who are eligible for Medicaid or (2) who are uninsured and whose household income is not greater than 300% of the federal poverty level.

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: No corporation shall practice dentistry or engage therein, or hold itself out as being entitled to practice dentistry, or furnish dental services or dentists, or advertise under or assume the title of dentist or dental surgeon or equivalent title, or furnish dental advice for any compensation

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: Any dentist who employs or engages the services of any dental laboratory to construct or repair, extraorally, prosthetic dentures, bridges, or other replacements for a part of a tooth, a tooth, or teeth, or who directs a dental laboratory to participate in shade selection for a prosthetic appliance, shall furnish such dental laboratory with a written prescription on forms prescribed by the Department

denture_patient_identification_marking_r.quote: Every complete upper and lower denture and removable dental prosthesis fabricated by a dentist, or fabricated pursuant to his or her prescription, shall be marked with the name of the patient for whom the prosthesis is intended. The markings shall be done during fabrication and shall be permanent, legible and cosmetically acceptable.

teledentistry_authorized.quote: "Teledentistry" means the use of telehealth systems and methodologies in dentistry and includes patient diagnosis, treatment planning, care, and education delivery for a patient of record using synchronous and asynchronous communications under an Illinois licensed dentist's authority as provided under this Act.

hygienist_local_anesthesia_certification.quote: administration of local anesthetics upon successful completion of a training program approved by the Department

hygienist_nitrous_oxide_certification_re.quote: administration and monitoring of nitrous oxide upon successful completion of a training program approved by the Department

restorative_function_endorsement_availab.quote: a dental hygienist may engage in the placing, carving, and finishing of amalgam restorations only after obtaining formal education and certification as determined by the Department

patient_record_retention_years.quote: Dental records required by this Section shall be maintained for 10 years.

cpr_certification_required_for_sedation.quote: ensure that the dentist has completed and maintains current certification in advanced cardiac life support or pediatric advanced life support and all persons assisting the dentist or monitoring the administration of general anesthesia, deep sedation, or moderate sedation maintain current certification in Basic Life Support (BLS)

dental_hygienist_alternative_practice_li.quote: A public health dental hygienist may provide services to patients: (1) who are eligible for Medicaid or (2) who are uninsured and whose household income is not greater than 300% of the federal poverty level.
